title: Urgent Repairs
description: Magar is transporting goods to Springvale, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

mainQuestExcel.title: Urgent Repairs

dialogs.text: Thank you, Traveler. Ugh, trust me to find a way to balls everything up...
If I can't even take a cart of wine from A to B without running into trouble... What good am I for anything?

I'll be fired from the Winery if I don't get my act together... That is, if Mr. Connor isn't on to me already. Ugh, I bet Mr. Elzer's drafting up my dismissal letter as I speak... It's hopeless, it's all hope—
Whoa Nelly! Calm down.
*sigh* Well, even if my job situation is beyond hope, I should still get this cart to its destination.
The cart's also been damaged... Traveler, could I trouble you to help me find what I need? Just one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Plank</color> will be enough.

flow.stepDescription: Give the Sturdy Plank to Magar

dialogs.text: That'll do the trick. I should be able to fix the cart now. I think. I hope...
Shoot, they're back! Help me, Traveler!
Phew... Thank goodness you are here, Traveler.
But I don't know how I'm going to fix my cart now, after that.
There's damage everywhere... I guess I'll have to patch it up as best I can. Whatever I do, it's not going to be a permanent fix.
Never mind. As long as it holds together for the journey into town, I can figure out the next step once I'm there.
I thought there was some rope in the cart... Gah, they must have made off with it.
Traveler... Why don't you take a look in the woods over there for me? If there's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Rope</color> around, that would be perfect.

Thank you, Traveler. That will do nicely.
This should hold out long enough to get me to Springvale. Once I've dropped off the goods there, I'll head back to the winery and update them on what went down.
Hopefully Elzer doesn't fire me on the spot when he sees what's happened to his cart...

Alright. Don't you worry.
Phew... Thanks. Meanwhile, I'll... have a— a think about how to fix the cart.
I'm afraid I have to go...
Don't go... Please. If I try, I—I'll only mess it up again. I need you. You're my only hope.
Will do.
Great. You do that, and I'll— I'll, uh, keep watch.
No can do.
Uh... But you're the only one around here who can help me, so... Thanks in advance...!
